diagnostics.note: diagnostic only (not a feature): the ruler canvas located the miss

agreements: v2 prediction: the same amber/grey splatter rings on black, central white ring and central dark hole; display luma tracks the capture frame by frame (within about 0.01 to frame 100)
v2 SDK text: a small centred ring (effective radius 0.08), max-normalised colour sitting on the 0.01 gate so the line flips between orange and black, warm tan/amber composite palette

misses.observed: canvas over-filled with red after frame 30 (display too dark, luma 0.20 vs 0.27 over time)
misses.cause: built-in wave blending took coverage from the line colour; a near-black (not maximised) wave had coverage ~0.01 and never cut the feedback, so the black seed that grows the central hole was missing
misses.fix: coverage from the raster mask (_blend_wave_layer); general for every dark built-in wave

misses.observed: text sized the ring at radius 0.5 and called the colour change subtle
misses.cause: recipe gave the nominal base radius without the wave_mystery offset and no maximise gate

misses.observed: text calls the screen mostly dark with very short trails
misses.cause: warp_transfer channel mean (red kept whole, green/blue cleared) read as 'one third kept, halving 0.6 frames'; the difference-of-blurs pattern term has no mechanism
misses.fix: per_channel transfer (channel_selective); blur-difference mechanism is the next step

verdict: understood by the prediction (v2); SDK text partially (screen coverage and pattern formation open)
